_keys_note: Discrete(85) full command set; we expose movement + eat. Compass 0-7 (0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW); 29=EAT. Arrows map to the cardinals, y/u/b/n to the diagonals, E to eat. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: You're hungry. Walk onto the food on the ground,
then press E to eat it.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / U        move diagonally  NW / NE
B / N        move diagonally  SW / SE
